text:
maria: hey @channel seeing failed SCIM provisioning for several users after KMS key rotation this morning. Errors show up as 'decryption failed: wrong key' in scim-service logs

sam: yup getting alerts. SCIM job batch 42: 15/20 failed. log snippet: `error=decryption_failed key_alias="alias/redwood-scim"`

anya: did we rotate that alias yesterday? i pushed a key version to alias/redwood-scim:v2 during the maintenance window. didn't update any service configs though

ryan: idp side uses KMS to decrypt SAML attribute blobs. OIDC token flow still looks fine, but i'm pulling CloudTrail now to see who called Decrypt

infra-bot: kms:Decrypt called 78 times in last 30m, 12 failed, requester=ec2-i-0abcd1234 (scim-provisioner)

maria: also seeing auth portal errors with JWT aud mismatch around same time: `jwt: aud="redwood-internal" expected="redwood-api"` — maybe unrelated but suspicious

sam: hotfix idea: re-point alias back to previous key material (rollback) to restore decrypts quickly. alternate: add fallback decrypt attempt with old key id in scim-service. which is less blasty?

anya: fallback requires KMS decrypt permissions for the old key which the service currently doesn't have. reverting alias is faster but we should avoid mass rollbacks.

ryan: i can re-point alias for now to stop customer impact. will do a controlled revert and monitor. opening incident INC-2026.

sec-oncall: please export all KMS Decrypt events to S3 and tag them for the incident. we need to confirm no secrets leaked. also check recent RBAC changes — did anyone change kms-admins or key policy?

maria: terraform plan shows no IAM changes in last 48h, but CloudTrail has a PutKeyPolicy at 02:14 UTC that was manual (console). looks like an automated step in the maintenance runbook failed and someone retried manually

sam: after rolling alias back, SCIM jobs resumed. 18/18 succeeded in the next run. we should still do a postmortem and a proper zero-downtime rotation plan

anya: agreed. proposed steps: 1) implement dual-key decrypt in scim-service (try new key then fallback), 2) introduce an alias-canary pattern so we can test new key without switching alias globally, 3) require approver + automated policy for PutKeyPolicy changes, 4) update runbook with rollback hammer

ryan: alias reverted at 2387654350 UTC. monitoring: error rate dropped to baseline. incident remains open until postmortem and action items are done

maria: thanks all. i'll gather logs, add timeline to the incident doc, and start the postmortem draft. runbook template: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kms-rotate 

sam: quick diagnostic command to reproduce audit query: ```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=alias/redwood-scim --start-time 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-20T04:00:00Z
```

sec-oncall: assign owners: anya -> runbook + PR for dual-decrypt, infra -> alias canary, security -> review PutKeyPolicy and approve new guardrails.

anya: will open PR for dual-decrypt this afternoon, include integration test that exercises both keys.

ryan: filing follow-up ticket to add a non-disruptive KMS alias rotation checklist to the infra runbooks.

maria: :thumbsup: closing loop here for now. postmortem doc link will be in INC-2026 when ready.
